title: The Eyes — Overview
description: Top-level health dashboard for the burritbot observability layer: OTel Collector ingest rate, gen_ai.* coverage and the orbweaver-weighted conformance score of the GenAI spans the collector receives (its count/genai connector).

panels.title: gen_ai.* coverage (%)
panels.description: Answered GenAI spans carrying every required Weaver registry attribute, conforming.

panels.title: gen_ai.* conformance score (orbweaver weights)

targets.expr: (1 * (sum(rate(burritbot_burritbot_genai_spans_conforming_gen_ai_provider_name_total[5m])) or vector(0)) + 1 * (sum(rate(burritbot_burritbot_genai_spans_conforming_gen_ai_request_model_total[5m])) or vector(0)) + 0.8 * (sum(rate(burritbot_burritbot_genai_spans_conforming_gen_ai_usage_input_tokens_total[5m])) or vector(0)) + 0.8 * (sum(rate(burritbot_burritbot_genai_spans_conforming_gen_ai_usage_output_tokens_total[5m])) or vector(0)) + 0.5 * (sum(rate(burritbot_burritbot_genai_spans_conforming_burritbot_layer_total[5m])) or vector(0)) + 0.5 * (sum(rate(burritbot_burritbot_genai_spans_conforming_burritbot_guarded_total[5m])) or vector(0))) / (4.6 * sum(rate(burritbot_burritbot_genai_spans_total[5m])))

panels.description: spinybacked-orbweaver's attribute weights over the conforming-span counts; 1.0 when every weighted attribute conforms. Its score_threshold is 0.85.
